title: 2018-05-07 Ein Muldenkipper im Steinbruch Unterbalbach
author: Triplec85
changes: A real dump truck at work in a stone quarry: a heavy, crunching rumble of rocks with the whine of the truck's machinery. Trimmed to 18.00–20.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Audio track of a video of a dump truck (German: Muldenkipper) in the Unterbalbach quarry, Germany.
